title: Vanilla Extras
description: Improving vanilla Minecraft with things we desire
body:
# Welcome to the Vanilla Extras project! A mod that aims to improve and extend the game in all ways desired!
**This mod is Work In Progress, expect bugs and errors.**

**_We were reborn!_** After a long time of not working on the project, I'm back! And with that a whole new chapter in the life of this mod has begun!

The mod (for now) offers many new armours tools and foods (for more information, check the changelog).

### Changes in V2-0.2 [LATEST]:
-Updated textures of cheese, doughnut and pizza.

-Fixed eggs in recipes to be able to use all 3 types of eggs.

-Added bottle of milk, bottle of heavy cream, croissant, butter, cheeseburger, langos and chicken soup.

-Updated doughnut recipe to give you more doughnuts.

-Fixed the stacking of foods in bowls.

_For more information bug reporting and suggestions please join our discord server_

**If you like the mod, make sure to follow and share with your friends! :P**

> ---Made with love using Mcreator <3---
